SELECT m.id AS meter_id, m.meter_no, m.meter_name, m.meter_type, m.display_type, m.unit, m.status, m.version, rm.created_at AS bound_at FROM resident_meter AS rm INNER JOIN meter AS m ON m.id = rm.meter_id WHERE rm.resident_id = #{residentId} AND m.deleted = 0
AND (m.meter_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.meter_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY rm.created_at DESC, rm.meter_id DESC
